policy: Seven origin cohorts; adult occupational/royal role assigned once at eighteen; artisan professions rotate across craft, trade, medicine, law and entertainment. One quarter free, three quarters Premium. Canonical career IDs validated, including poacher_job. Reload checkpoints at twelve, thirty and fifty. Two work actions, rest below 75 health, deterministic stated decision policy with hash tie breaks, peaceful RPG resolution. Actual mortality; no invulnerability. Availability sampled only when a cohort survives to the stated age.

history.text: You arrive during a rent dispute. Simon offers the bailiff a chicken; Edith offers him the door. You inherit neither victory nor dry bedding.
🙏 From the cradle you are Pious. Born with a prayer already on the lips.
A persistent Swineford begins. Its families, rivalries, wars, and unfinished tales will outlive any single character.
You discover that dropping a spoon makes an adult fetch it. An excellent arrangement, briefly.
Thomas rises from Market Hawker to Trader.
Agnes begins work as Market Hawker.
Mathilda settles in Swineford seeking work and a safer roof.
Bjorn settles in Swineford seeking work and a safer roof.
Aldric settles in Swineford seeking work and a safer roof.
Edith moves the candle. The stranger goes home without requiring you to be brave for an audience.
A winter cough keeps you awake. Edith warms your blanket by the hearth and stays until your breathing settles.
Lord Aldric rises from Steward to Chancellor.
Leofric rises from Tenant Farmer to Reeve.
Cecily settles in Swineford seeking work and a safer roof.
Your first clear word is “more.” Edith looks pleased until you begin applying it to everything.
Sir Quackbeard lets you sit nearby while he preens. It is a quiet friendship with rather strict terms of admission.
Merek rises from Market Hawker to Trader.
Joan rises from Man-at-Arms to Marshal.
Edith retrieves it, then moves the bowl beyond your jurisdiction.
You slip beside the watering trough. A bystander offers advice after you have stopped needing it.

A stool gives way under the only person who had just called the meeting to order.
